response.rationale: The presence of LTBP2 variants, lens dislocation, and glaucoma strongly supports LTBP2-related disorder. Normal echocardiogram and tall stature argue against Marfan and Weill-Marchesani, respectively. Homocystinuria and sulfite oxidase deficiency are less likely given the genetic finding.
